what: How often the shipped semantic gate calls tau2/airline an environment with no correct answer. It has one.
why: gate_reliability.json measures this per run and found 1 in 7, which no affordable number of corpus runs can bound. Per environment the same decision costs seconds, so it can be bounded rather than observed.
reading: 0 false overrides in 50 trials on the shipped path. One-sided 95% upper bound on the per-decision rate: 5.8%. That is a bound, not a demonstration that the rate is zero.
